author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** Stand Polaris up as a first-class labeler service: host the labeler XRPC endpoints, sign and emit labels, consume third-party labeler signals, preserve evidence, validate label records client-side, and complete the security hardening (audit chain, threat-model coverage, signing-key custody, rotation tooling). Maps to design.md §11 M4 and `.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` REQ-1, REQ-2, REQ-3, REQ-4 (second half), REQ-9, REQ-10, REQ-11, REQ-12, REQ-13.

**Children (10).** XRPC labeler endpoint; publish-labeler-record CLI; label signing; SigningKey trait + 4 impls; key-rotate CLI; AtprotoOauthAuthVerifier; inbound third-party labels; evidence-CAR worker; lexicon validation engine in wasm bundle; hash-chained audit log.

**Done when.** All 16 acceptance criteria in `.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` pass; threat-model coverage tests green; beta-with-partner-labeler exit criteria from design.md §11 M4 met.

**Rust-quality.**
- Cryptographic correctness rules (`.crosslink/rules/rigor.md` §Cryptographic correctness) apply at every signing/verification site — fresh RNG, audited libraries (`k256` via `proto-blue-crypto`), authenticated ciphertext where applicable, current algorithms.
- The `SigningKey` trait is `Send + Sync` and never panics — every error becomes a typed `SigningError` variant.
- `unsafe` is banned in this milestone too; if KMS bindings require FFI, isolate in a single crate with `// SAFETY:` documentation + `cargo miri test`.
